etymology: ラテン語 flos(花:flora・flourish と同じ根) → 花 → (花ざかり)いちばんよい時 → (動詞)花がさく

en_definitions.text: the colored part of a plant that produces seeds; a plant grown for its flowers.
to produce flowers; to develop fully.

cautions: flower=花(ふつう)/blossom=(果樹の)花/bloom=(観賞用の)花・開花
